# RangeSlider

Fluent styled RangeSlider.

## Example

```qml
RangeSlider {
    id: range
    from: 0; to: 100
    first.value: 20
    second.value: 80
}
```

## API

Style-only control: no extra QWinUI3 properties. Use the Qt Quick Controls `RangeSlider` API (this file only supplies Fluent visuals / metrics).
